title: Noise2Noise
paper_title: Noise2Noise: Learning Image Restoration without Clean Data
core_mech: 使用同一信号的两次独立无偏噪声实现进行 noisy-to-noisy 监督，训练阶段不需要干净靶图。
core_mech_en: Trains a denoising network using pairs of independent noisy realizations (y_1, y_2) of the same underlying anatomy without ever observing clean ground truth.
input_desc: 同一潜在图像 x 的两次独立含噪观测 y1、y2
input_en: Two independent noisy observations (y_1, y_2) of the exact same underlying clean signal x
output_desc: 以单次含噪观测为输入的条件均值估计 x_hat
output_en: Clean conditional expectation estimate x̂ = f_θ(y_1)

source.title: Noise2Noise
notes: License conditions exceed this project's MIT grant. Keep this upstream source under its own terms; this registry does not vendor or relicense it.

adapter.name: Noise2Noise
adapter.mechanism: Regress a second independent unclipped zero-mean noisy acquisition from the first; clean data is not read by the loss.
limitations: Compact U-Net instead of the original TensorFlow architecture; independence is a dataset assumption, not inferred from image appearance.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
